title: The Faded Poster
scene: At 5:15 PM, the print shop master poster was scrubbed blank. The press floor was locked from 5:00 to 5:30.

suspects.name: Leo Ash
suspects.testimony: I was at the counter at 5:15, wrapping copies.
suspects.alibiProof: The counter camera shows Leo wrapping at 5:14.

suspects.name: Mina Sato
suspects.testimony: I was in the office at 5:15, emailing the client.
suspects.alibiProof: Mina's email was sent at 5:13 from the office network.

suspects.name: Nate Cole
suspects.testimony: I was in the stockroom at 5:15, counting paper.
suspects.alibiProof: The stockroom log shows Nate's count at 5:12 and 5:19.

suspects.name: Opal Vale
suspects.testimony: I was at the front door at 5:15, locking up early.
suspects.contradiction: The door was locked from 5:00, and solvent stained Opal's apron.
